# Nora

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
- **Origin:** Andrews’ Cove  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Nora is characterized by her black hair and matching black eyes. She also features a distinct, elfin face.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v3 ch.People P11](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0011)_

## History

Nora was an imaginative friend created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), who pictured her as one of his shore companions alongside the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md). In a creative letter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) detailed fantastical adventures with Nora and his other imaginary friends, including sailing into a moonglade. Nora was later left behind as [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) grew up and moved away from his childhood imaginings.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P10](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0010), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P14](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0014), +36 more_
